rules.question: Are all external inputs validated server-side?
rules.applies_if: HTTP endpoints, APIs, or form inputs present

rules.question: Does validation leverage allowlists whenever possible?
Are invalid inputs rejected?
Do SQL queries use parameters instead of input concatenation?
Is unsafe string concatenation absent in SQL generation?
Are shell arguments parameterized?
Is command injection impossible?
Is dynamic code execution (code injection) absent?
Does HTML output use contextual encoding?
rules.applies_if: Rendering untrusted data into HTML contexts

rules.question: Does JavaScript, CSS, and URL output use contextual encoding?
rules.applies_if: Rendering untrusted data into script/style/link contexts

rules.question: Do templates refrain from executing untrusted input as code?
Are user-supplied file paths prevented from path traversal?
rules.applies_if: Accessing file system via user input

rules.question: Do symlinks or canonical paths refrain from breaking out of authorized directories?
Is untrusted data deserialization secure?
Are user-controlled regex patterns free from ReDoS vulnerabilities?
Are input sizes and computational costs bounded?
rules.applies_if: Parsing large files or CPU-intensive algorithms

rules.question: Does every sensitive function require authentication?
rules.applies_if: APIs or actions impacting system data or state

rules.question: Does authentication refrain from relying solely on client-controllable data?
Is authenticated identity verified server-side?
Is every requested object authorized against the current user?
Do user-provided IDs refrain from allowing IDOR or BOLA?
Does every sensitive function enforce the required role?
Is every modifiable property authorized independently?
Does mass assignment refrain from modifying protected fields?
rules.applies_if: Directly binding HTTP payloads to domain models

rules.question: Is privilege escalation impossible?
rules.applies_if: Role management, permissions, and user updates

rules.question: Do cookie-based state-changing operations have CSRF protection?
Is the client prevented from bypassing authorization or business rules?
Are authorizations re-evaluated upon role or session changes?
Do sensitive operations enforce rate limiting?
rules.applies_if: Auth, payment, email dispatch, or password reset endpoints

rules.question: Do sensitive business flows feature abuse and automation protections?
rules.applies_if: Public endpoints prone to scraping or bot abuse

rules.question: Are hardcoded secrets absent from the code?
Are secrets excluded from log outputs?
Are secrets excluded from error messages?
Are secrets stored in an appropriate secret manager?
rules.applies_if: Credential or API key storage and retrieval

rules.question: Is key rotation supported?
Are standard cryptographic primitives used?
Is proprietary or custom cryptography absent?
rules.applies_if: Using custom encryption algorithms or schemes

rules.question: Is sensitive data protected in transit?
rules.applies_if: Network communications, API calls, or socket channels

rules.question: Is sensitive data protected at rest when required?
rules.applies_if: Persisting PII, tokens, or credentials in storage/DB

rules.question: Does TLS validation verify certificate, hostname, and trust chain?
Are random number generators used for security cryptographically secure?
rules.applies_if: Generating tokens, nonces, salts, or keys

rules.question: Are passwords prevented from being stored in plaintext?
Do tokens have verified expiration, audience, and issuer?
Do self-contained tokens verify signature or MAC before use?
Are token algorithms restricted to an allowlist?
Is the 'none' algorithm strictly rejected?
Is key confusion between symmetric and asymmetric algorithms prevented?
rules.applies_if: JWT signature verification (e.g., HMAC vs RSA/ECDSA)

rules.question: Do token keys originate from trusted, allowlisted sources?
Do jku, x5u, and jwk URLs refrain from permitting arbitrary sources?
rules.applies_if: Using JWT headers for key resolution

rules.question: Does CORS enforce an allowlist of origins?
rules.applies_if: Configuring CORS headers on web APIs

rules.question: Do sensitive cookies include the Secure flag?
Do sensitive cookies include the HttpOnly flag?
Do sensitive cookies set an appropriate SameSite attribute?
Do sensitive responses prevent shared caching?
rules.applies_if: HTTP response headers for private data

rules.question: Are applicable security headers configured?
Do HTML pages enforce an appropriate Content Security Policy (CSP)?
rules.applies_if: Server-side HTML rendering or Single Page Applications

rules.question: Is HTTP traffic protected with HSTS where applicable?
rules.applies_if: Web server or HTTPS middleware configuration

rules.question: Is 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' present where applicable?
rules.applies_if: HTTP responses serving static or dynamic payloads

rules.question: Is clickjacking prevented?
Are server version details hidden from unnecessary exposure?
Do endpoints refrain from exposing more data than necessary?
Do downloadable files specify an appropriate Content-Disposition header?
Do downloadable files specify a safe content type?
Do uploads constrain file size, type, and name?
Are uploaded files stored outside executable web paths?
rules.applies_if: Storing uploaded files to local disk

rules.question: Are uploaded files prevented from executing as code?
Do user-controlled URLs refrain from permitting open redirects?
rules.applies_if: Redirects based on query parameters or payload input

rules.question: Are server-side requests to external URLs protected against SSRF?
rules.applies_if: Server issuing network requests driven by user input

rules.question: Are SSRF targets restricted from accessing internal networks or metadata endpoints?
Do incoming webhooks verify origin authenticity and integrity?
Do sensitive operations generate audit logs?
rules.applies_if: Administrative actions, permission changes, or critical data edits

rules.question: Are audit logs protected against unauthorized modification?
Do security events trigger alerts when necessary?
rules.applies_if: Authentication failure detection or anomaly monitoring

rules.question: Are production configurations free of debug mode or insecure defaults?
Do applied permissions adhere to the principle of least privilege?
rules.applies_if: Assigning permissions to processes, DB users, or service accounts

rules.question: Is data originating from APIs, logs, files, and configs treated as untrusted?
rules.applies_if: Reading external data at process boundaries

rules.question: Does the change refrain from weakening existing input validation, allowlists, or security checks?
rules.applies_if: Modifying validation logic, regexes, allowlists, or guard conditions

rules.question: Is untrusted content prevented from executing as code in rendered output?
rules.applies_if: Rendering user-controlled data as HTML, SVG, or URLs

rules.question: Do NoSQL queries refrain from passing untrusted input as operators or expressions?
rules.applies_if: Building document-store queries from external input

rules.question: Do deep merges and dynamic key assignments filter __proto__, constructor, and prototype?
rules.applies_if: Merging external objects or assigning dynamic keys

rules.question: Do password hashes use a memory-hard function with an appropriate work factor?
Do authentication failures return indistinguishable responses for unknown users and wrong credentials?
rules.applies_if: Login, password reset, or account recovery flows

rules.question: Do sessions enforce absolute and idle expiration, and rotate on authentication changes?
rules.applies_if: Session management, login, or privilege changes

rules.question: Are password-reset tokens random, single-use, and short-lived?
rules.applies_if: Password reset or account recovery flows

rules.question: Are API keys stored hashed, scoped, and rotatable?
Are secret credentials kept out of client-side bundles?
rules.applies_if: Frontend code, mobile clients, or edge functions

rules.question: Is full payment-card PAN never stored, logged, or persisted?
Are monetary amounts and prices sourced server-side rather than trusted from the client?
